scope: MEAS: independent numerical, published bar-map, provenance, report and visual review; not aural review.

defects.evidence: The complete-source audit /tmp/score-a-curious-happiness-voice-audit.json found independently written bassvoices A2 quarter-note reattacks in printed bars 4 and 12 suppressed by legacy shared-channel MIDI. The 93 coincident unisons and two modern grace-clock moves are separately classified, not excuses for missing distinct attacks.
defects.fix: Regenerate all four isolated named piano source voices, preserving the A2 reattacks and their overlapping written holds in every performed occurrence. Keep the half-open partial-bar return order, recompute unchanged gates, inspect fresh overlays, re-resolve the nine listener pointers, and update counts/report/source-voice metadata.

resolution.finding: The listener's obsolete 46-second return, strain estimate and pickup wording were corrected; nine bar pointers resolved against the earlier publication. Those caller repairs remain resolved independently of the newly discovered source-attack omission, which now requires complete-voice republication.

report.finding: The earlier 673-note publication agreed with timing gates and the 42-occurrence/81-quarter performed order, but its legacy source MIDI suppressed two independent A2 attacks. Update this inventory/report after complete four-source-voice regeneration; passing aggregate onset gates alone does not establish source fidelity.

barMap.finding: Actual SVG/index bars are 0–24, including real pickup glyphs in bar 0. Score order is 0–24, then the last 0.5 quarter of bar 8 and bars 9–24. All 673 note indices resolve, durations are positive, and bar occurrence times strictly increase. The single engraved page was visually inspected. All six bar-anchored cues and three transition anchors resolve to exactly one published bar occurrence and agree with the corrected repeat description.

overlays.finding: No gross pitch/order mismatch identified. Both A and B returns have corresponding melodic/bass contours; no second compressed A cycle is required on the return. Earlier coarse 46-second return inference is superseded by this evidence.

version.finding: Original piano scoring with AABAB performed order: source writes A+A+B, followed here by the returning pickup and A+B rather than a complete second A+A+B traversal. Source staff aggregation does not identify separately recovered performed voices.

limitations: MEAS: No aural review, build or browser integration check was performed by VerS. The source, inferred performed order and timing remain explicitly provisional.
